Thursday, May 2nd, 2024

Minutes

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill

Senator Matt D. Klein called the meeting to order at 8:34 a.m.

Approval of the minutes from 5/1/24.

The minutes were approved as presented.

S.F. 5234: Senator Rest Omnibus Tax Bill.

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5234, as amended, be taken from the table. MOTION
PREVAILED.

Senator Rest moved the A-12 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Rest moved the A-11 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

The gavel was passed to Senator Weber.

Senator Klein moved the A-4 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

The gavel was passed to Senator Klein.

Senator Weber moved the A-8 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Nelson moved the A-5 amendment and incorporated on line 1.12: delete “75” and insert
“25”. The motion prevailed and the amendment, as amended, was adopted.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-6 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5234 as amended be recommended to pass. MOTION
PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 9:04 a.m.
